read.en: Nvidia fell 5.5% on Nov 10 to $168.89, trading $165.89–174.65 on heavy volume (3.10x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($183.2), 10-day ($195.8), 30-day ($214.9), 100-day ($213.3) and 200-day ($204.5); all five averages are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($195.83), and RSI is 24.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月10日下跌 5.5%，收于 $168.89，盘中区间 $165.89–174.65，成交量放大（20 日均量的 3.10 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$183.2）、10 日（$195.8）、30 日（$214.9）、100 日（$213.3）和 200 日（$204.5）均线下方；五条均线均在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$195.83），RSI 为 24。

read.en: The close broke both supports, $176.8–177.6 (Jan 20 and Oct 2025 lows) and $170.2 (Nov 9 low), now resistance; the $165.89 low came within 1% of the $164.27 52-week low (Mar 30). Resistance is $170.2–174.7 (Nov 9 low, Nov 10 high), then $176.8–179.9 and $183.2 (5-day). Support is $164.3–165.9, then $160. A close above $174.7 would target $177–180; below $164.3, $160.

r.en: Oct 22, 2025 and Jan 20 lows ($176.76–177.61), lost; Nov 9 high $179.92
